content:
The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The verifier failed with an AssertionError in test_derived_values_and_stats. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 in the 'Task' sheet returned #NAME? instead of the expected numerical values. This indicates that the generated Excel formulas use undefined names, unsupported functions, or incorrect syntax. While the file structure and lookup blocks passed, the derived statistics calculations regressed the reward from 1.00 to 0.00.
